description: The Rust-lane dogfood mission as probed so far: three real consumers (Baldim's S3 adapter, redskilled's CLI and statusline, redwall's renderer) compiled with no JavaScript engine. The entries mirror the probe history; the maintainer owns the definition of done and this file does not define acceptance criteria.

main.description: the main scriptc checkout; defaults to the parent of the git common directory, so a worktree finds the consumers beside the main checkout

workspace.description: the directory holding the consumer repositories as siblings of the main checkout

baldim.description: the installed Baldim S3 probe workspace: the tracked fixture after `npm ci`, or an already installed probe directory through the override

entries.name: baldim-s3-smoke
entries.description: Offline S3Client constructor smoke test over @baldim/adapter-s3: construct with dummy credentials, print the resolved config, destroy.

entries.name: baldim-aws-only
entries.description: The AWS SDK slice alone: construct an @aws-sdk/client-s3 S3Client and destroy it.

entries.name: redskilled-statusline
entries.description: The redskilled statusline renderer entry: the only redskilled entry that has reached lowering so far.

entries.name: redwall-render
entries.note: Targets a dirty red-dev working tree through an ad hoc wrapper in the main checkout's scratch directory; another workstream is requalifying redwall against a clean clone and this entry will be replaced at integration.
entries.description: The redwall renderer through the existing audit wrapper (renderRedwall over the red-dev sources).
